en: 'A lone Trainer, a dragon at her side, crossing the world in search of the truth...' Forgive me, that's a line from the novel I'm writing.
You must be the challenger. I'm Shauntal of the Elite Four. My Ghost-type Pokémon and I will be your opponents.
Back again? Good! Every return is a new chapter. Let's write this one together!
Every Pokémon on the field fought on, hurting and tired. Thank you, all of you. What a chapter that was.
A light began to glow in the corner of the room.
Battles hurt, for us and for our Pokémon. Remember that, and you'll never forget the bonds you share.
That's what I try to put into my stories.
The light carried {player} back down to the hall.
